en.commentary: I rank the Midea Cube 50 first and I will defend that call. It is the fastest moisture remover in the field, its collapsible body slides into a closet, and the 4.2-gallon tank means I empty it about a third as often as a standard 50-pint bucket. The pump version takes second because a basement without a floor drain needs that lift, and I would still keep a spare drain hose on hand since pumps are the first part to wear. Frigidaire's FHDD5034W1 lands third at roughly $268 with Energy Star certification and app control, a very easy purchase. The hOmeLabs HME1003 is my value pick at around $180: it took a test room from 90% to 40% humidity in 9 minutes 17 seconds while drawing 552 W. The AEOCKY Rhea-003 sits in the middle of my list because its 1.3 L/kWh efficiency and 57.3 dBA are the best numbers HouseFresh recorded, and it suits a whole-basement setup where a $500 price makes sense. Every unit here is rated 50 pints under the AHAM standard, so the differences come down to tank size, drainage, noise and watts. Buy on those four, and skip the marketing pint number.

highlights.title: Midea Cube 50 earns first place on tank size and speed
highlights.body: The Cube removed moisture faster than every other unit in the field, and its 4.2-gallon tank gives roughly three times the run time between dumps. In a Taiwan-style humid apartment that stays closed for days, that one feature saves a real chore. The collapsible body and wheels are a bonus.

highlights.title: Buy the pump version only for a drain-less basement
highlights.body: The pump model of the Cube lifts water to a sink or window, which solves the drain-less basement problem completely. Pumps are the first wearing part, so I keep a gravity drain hose as a backup and check the pump each season.

highlights.title: The hOmeLabs HME1003 is the value anchor
highlights.body: At about $180 it cleared a test room from 90% to 40% humidity in 9 minutes 17 seconds and drew 552 W at 50% RH. The 1.6-gallon tank fills quickly, so a drain hose is the way to run it.

highlights.title: AEOCKY Rhea-003 is the efficiency leader
highlights.body: HouseFresh recorded 1.3 L/kWh at 357.55 W and 57.3 dBA at top speed. A 3-year warranty and up to 7,000 sq ft of coverage make it my whole-floor recommendation for buyers who can spend $500.

highlights.title: Read tank, drain, noise and watts before the pint rating
highlights.body: Every unit here carries a 50-pint AHAM rating, so the real differences show up in how often you empty the tank, where the water goes, how loud the fan gets and what the meter reads. That is where I put my scoring weight.

zh-tw.commentary: Midea Cube 50 排第一，這個結論我很有把握。它的除濕速度是這批機種裡最快的，機身可以折疊收進櫃子，4.2 加侖的大水箱讓我倒水的次數只有一般 50 品脫機種的三分之一左右，梅雨季悶在房間裡的時候真的很有感。內建排水泵的版本排第二，地下室或一樓沒有地漏的家庭需要這個抽水功能，不過泵浦是最先損耗的零件，我會建議另外備一條排水管當後路。Frigidaire FHDD5034W1 排第三，大約 268 美元，有 Energy Star 認證跟 App 控制，買起來很安心。預算有限的話我會看 hOmeLabs HME1003，大約 180 美元，實測小空間從 90% 降到 40% 只要 9 分 17 秒，運轉耗電 552 W，這個價位很難挑剔。AEOCKY Rhea-003 效率 1.3 L/kWh、全速 57.3 dBA，是 HouseFresh 測到最漂亮的數字，整層樓要一次處理的話它值得 500 美元。這批機種全部標 50 品脫，差別只在水箱大小、排水方式、噪音跟耗電，挑機器就看這四項，別被品脫數字牽著走。

highlights.title: Midea Cube 50 靠水箱跟速度拿下第一
highlights.body: Cube 的除濕速度是這批裡最快的，4.2 加侖水箱讓倒水間隔拉長到約三倍。台灣公寓潮濕、窗戶關個好幾天的時候，這個差別就是日常少一件雜事。可折疊機身跟輪子是加分項。

en.commentary:
The Midea Cube 50 keeps first place, and the 2026 lists from RTINGS and CNN Underscored back that call. RTINGS describes the Cube as lowering humidity faster than any other 50-pint unit it has tested while drawing the least power, which makes it very efficient. That matches what I care about most: how quickly a damp room gets back to a comfortable 45 to 50 percent humidity, and what it costs to keep the machine running through autumn.

The oversized tank is the other reason I put it on top. I empty it far less often than a standard bucket, and the collapsible body slides into a closet when the season ends. The pump version at second is my pick for a basement without a floor drain, since the pump lifts water to a sink or hose run.

CNN Underscored also singled out a Wi-Fi Frigidaire Gallery model with a built-in pump that collected the most water in its testing and has an app that is easy to use. My third-place Frigidaire FHDD5034W1 is a related pick, and the GE APYR50LC at eighth shows up in RTINGS' list as well. For any of these, place the unit away from walls, keep the filter clean and set a target humidity so it does not run nonstop. No score moves today, since the new coverage confirms the order I already have.

highlights.body: RTINGS says the Cube lowers humidity faster than other 50-pint units while drawing the least power.

highlights.body: The 4.2-gallon tank means fewer trips to the sink.

en.commentary:
Midea Cube 50 keeps first place, and today I want to walk through the choice between the standard Cube and the pump version, since both sit at the top of my table. The standard Cube scores 9.6 for drainage and 9.0 for value. The pump version scores 9.4 for drainage and 8.4 for value, and it earns that extra money when the unit sits far from a floor drain.

Both share 9.6 for capacity, 9.3 for noise and 9.4 for efficiency, so the core dehumidifying performance is identical. RTINGS and CNN Underscored both place the Cube among their 2026 top picks. My decision rule is simple: if your basement has a drain within reach, buy the standard Cube. If the water has to travel up a stair or across a room, the pump version removes the daily chore of emptying a bucket.

The Frigidaire 50 Pint FHDD5034W1 in third has a 9.3 value score and 9.0 for capacity, which makes it a smart pick for a garage or a laundry room where quiet matters less. Its 8.4 noise score is the trade for the price.

As autumn brings damp basements and closed windows, I would size the unit to the room and run it on a humidistat setting near 50 percent. My scores stay unchanged today, and I am not aware of any new event in the past week that changes these three.

en.commentary:
Midea Cube keeps first place, and this year's outside test coverage actually splits between two different machines, which gives me a good chance to explain what my value weighting is doing. Consumer Reports describes the GE APYR50LC as the dehumidifier it rates highest for large rooms, built around a genuinely powerful 50 pint AHAM capacity and a top fan speed that moves air well through an open floor plan. My own table has the GE sitting in eighth place at a 7.2 for value, because that capacity comes with a price that most single-room buyers do not need to pay.

CNN Underscored's own third party testing points the other direction, reporting that the Midea Cube pulled high humidity down faster than any other 50 pint unit it tried. That result matches the two numbers that keep the Cube first in my table, a 9.6 for capacity and a 9.6 for drainage, the bucket-in-condenser design that lets it run for days without a manual empty. The pump version stays close behind in second, trading a little value for the convenience of gravity-free drainage into a sink or a window line.

My advice depends on the room. A large basement or an open living area with real airflow needs justifies the GE's coverage and its price. A bedroom, a closet, or a single damp room is better served by the Cube, since drainage convenience and day to day capacity matter more there than maximum square footage on a spec sheet. Buy for the room you actually have, and let that decide the model.

CNN Underscored 自己做的第三方測試則指向另一個方向，報告寫說 Midea Cube 把高濕度拉下來的速度比它測過的任何一台 50 品脫機種都快。這個結果跟讓 Cube 守住第一名的兩個數字對得上，容量 9.6、排水 9.6，冷凝水槽內嵌進水桶的設計讓它能連跑好幾天不用手動倒水。幫浦版緊追在第二名，犧牲一點價值分數換來免重力排水的方便，可以直接接水槽或窗邊管線。

我的建議看房間而定。大坪數地下室或是真的有對流的開放式客廳，GE 的覆蓋範圍跟價格才划算。臥室、儲藏室、單一潮濕房間更適合 Cube，因為排水方便跟日常容量在這種空間比規格表上的坪數數字更重要。買的時候先看你實際的房間，再讓房型決定機種。

en.commentary:
Midea Cube keeps first place this week, and I want to use this update to look at the two models sitting just behind the podium, since neither gets enough attention in my own past write ups. Frigidaire's FHDD5034W1 holds third with a 9.3 for value, the second highest value score in this whole table, built on a 9.0 capacity number that covers most finished basements without the premium price Midea's pump version carries. hOmeLabs' HME1003 sits fourth right behind it, and its 9.6 for value is actually the single best number in the entire table, the trade off is a 7.6 for drainage, the lowest score among my top five, since its tank needs a manual empty more often than a unit with a larger reservoir or a pump line.

RTINGS, a lab I already trust for humidifier testing, has now expanded its own dehumidifier program to 22 units it purchased itself and tested at its own facility, the same independent buying standard that makes its other appliance categories worth reading closely. I look forward to seeing where the Cube and its pump sibling land once that full test set publishes, but the model I already prioritize for capacity, drainage convenience, and efficiency together remains unchanged this week.

My advice depends on how often you can empty a tank. If checking a bucket every few days is not realistic for your schedule, pay for the Cube's drainage convenience or the pump version's gravity free line. If you are disciplined about maintenance and want to spend less, the Frigidaire or the hOmeLabs both do the job for meaningfully less money, and their value scores prove it.

zh-tw.commentary:
Midea Cube 這週還是穩坐第一，這次我想聊聊排在它後面兩個型號，因為之前幾次更新都沒有特別提到它們。Frigidaire 的 FHDD5034W1 排名第三，性價比拿下 9.3 分，是整張表裡第二高的性價比分數，靠的是 9.0 的除濕量表現，涵蓋大部分裝潢好的地下室，卻不用付 Midea 幫浦版那種偏高的價格。hOmeLabs 的 HME1003 緊接在第四名，它的性價比 9.6 分其實是整張表裡最高的一個數字，代價是排水分數只有 7.6，是我前五名裡最低的，因為水箱需要比較頻繁手動倒水，沒有大容量水箱或幫浦排水線那麼省心。

我一直信任的評測網站 RTINGS，除濕機測試項目最近擴大到 22 台機器，每一台都是自己掏錢買回來、在自己的實驗室測試，不靠廠商送測，這跟他們加濕機測試一直以來的獨立標準一樣。我很期待看到 Cube 跟幫浦版在完整測試結果出來後會落在哪個位置，不過這週我依然把容量、排水便利性跟效率綜合起來考量後，維持原本最看好的機型不變。

我的建議要看你多常能倒水。如果每隔幾天檢查一次水箱對你的生活作息不實際，那就值得花錢買 Cube 的排水便利性，或是幫浦版那種不用重力排水的設計。如果你對維護很有紀律又想省點錢，Frigidaire 或 hOmeLabs 都做得到同樣的工作，價格卻便宜不少，性價比分數已經說明了一切。

en.commentary:
Midea Cube keeps first place this week, and I want to use two outside sources to check my own numbers against real testing, not spec sheets. RTINGS has now bought and independently tested 22 dehumidifiers for its 2026 lineup, and the GE APYR50LC, the unit sitting eighth on my own table, is one of the models in that batch, which matters because independent purchase and testing carries more weight than a review unit supplied by the brand, exactly the kind of verification my own capacity and drainage columns try to reward.

CNET's own dehumidifier guide, refreshed for the season, frames the whole category around the exact tradeoff my table is built on, matching unit size to space, not chasing the biggest number on the box. Their basement pick is a HomeLabs model rated for the largest square footage in their whole lineup, a different SKU than the hOmeLabs HME1003 I have sitting fourth, but built by the same company that already earns that unit a 9.6 value score on my table, the highest number in this entire list. Their under $200 pick, a compact Midea unit with voice control and a smaller tank, lines up with the same brand strength that puts two Midea Cube models in my own top two spots, quiet operation and efficiency that hold up even as capacity scales down.

I am not moving anything today. Two independent guides that tested and bought their own units, not simply relying on manufacturer claims, land on the same brands already anchoring the top and bottom of value on my table, which is exactly the kind of agreement that makes me comfortable holding this order into the fall humidity season.

highlights.body: RTINGS bought and tested 22 dehumidifiers for 2026, including the GE APYR50LC sitting eighth on my table, the kind of independent purchase testing that puts a real spec sheet claim to the test.

highlights.body: CNET's basement pick from HomeLabs covers the most square footage in their lineup, a different model than the hOmeLabs HME1003 on my table but built by the same brand earning it a table topping 9.6 value score.

highlights.title: Midea's efficiency scales down without losing quality
highlights.body: A compact Midea pick winning CNET's under $200 category for quiet, efficient operation reflects the same brand strength putting two Midea Cube models in my own top two spots.

CNET這次更新的除濕機指南，整篇建議的核心跟我自己表格的邏輯一樣，都是先看空間大小再選機型，不會一味追求箱子上寫的最大數字。他們的地下室首選是一台HomeLabs 機型，涵蓋坪數是整份名單裡最大的，雖然跟我表上排第四的hOmeLabs HME1003是不同型號，但出自同一個品牌，而這個品牌已經在我表上讓HME1003拿下整張表最高的9.6 value 分數。他們選出的200美元以下首選是一台小巧的Midea 機型，有語音控制、水箱比較小，這跟同一個品牌讓兩款Midea Cube 包辦我表上前兩名的特質一致，安靜省電的表現就算容量縮小也沒有打折扣。

en.commentary:
Midea Cube 50 Pint keeps the top spot, same reason as always: it's the only unit here scoring above 9.5 on drainage design while staying this quiet, and the bucket-and-pump model right behind it in second place proves Midea built one strong shared platform for both configurations.

Nothing shipped this week that changes this category. The dehumidifier market keeps expanding, with industry forecasts projecting the segment to clear $5 billion by the early 2030s as more households treat humidity control as health equipment. That growth is pulling in more brands at the budget tier, which is exactly where this list is already crowded, Waykar, GE, and Ivation all sit within half a point of each other in the seven-to-nine range on value and capacity.

Frigidaire's FHDD5034W1 holds third on a genuinely strong value score, 9.3, the highest in the entire lineup, which is why it beats several units with higher raw capacity numbers. hOmeLabs HME1003 stays fourth for the same reason: a 9.6 value score carries it past competitors with better drainage.

The move of Energy Star from the EPA to the Department of Energy this year changes no efficiency numbers here today, since none of these scores pull directly from an Energy Star label, but it's the kind of standards shift worth tracking into next year.

Everything below fifth place keeps its exact position from the last update.

highlights.title: Midea built one dehumidifier platform, and both versions of it work
highlights.body: Matching 9.6 capacity and 9.4 efficiency scores on both the standard and pump models show the engineering underneath is shared and equally solid across both.

highlights.title: Frigidaire and hOmeLabs win on value scores that beat their raw specs
highlights.body: A 9.3 and 9.6 value score respectively let both units outrank competitors with higher capacity numbers, proving price-to-performance still decides close calls here.

highlights.title: A crowded budget tier means small spec differences decide rank order
highlights.body: Waykar, GE, and Ivation sit within half a point of each other, so a single strong category score is enough to separate seventh from ninth.

highlights.title: Energy Star's move to DOE is a future consideration for next year's scores
highlights.body: None of this list's efficiency scores are pulled from Energy Star certification directly, so the agency handoff changes nothing about today's rankings.

zh-tw.commentary:
Midea Cube 50 Pint繼續守住第一名，它是這份名單裡唯一排水設計分數能超過9.5分、運轉又這麼安靜的機種，緊接在後的水箱加水泵版本更證明Midea打造的是同一套紮實平台，兩個版本的工程底子一樣扎實。

這星期沒有新品上市會改變這個類別的排名。除濕機市場持續擴大，產業預測顯示到2030年代初期市場規模將突破50億美元，越來越多家庭把濕度控制當成健康設備。這股成長也吸引更多品牌進入平價市場，剛好是這份名單目前最擁擠的區間，Waykar、GE跟Ivation三者分數彼此只差不到半分。

Frigidaire的FHDD5034W1靠紮實的CP值評分9.3分守住第三名，是整份名單裡最高的CP值分數。hOmeLabs HME1003排第四也是同樣道理，9.6分的CP值評分讓它超越排水表現更好的對手。

今年Energy Star從EPA移交給能源部，不會改動今天任何能效分數，但這類制度異動值得留意明年會不會有進一步變化。第五名以下排名完全維持上次順位。

highlights.body: 標準版跟水泵版容量都拿9.6分、能效都拿9.4分，代表背後的工程基礎是共用而且紮實的，不是旗艦機跟廉價版的落差組合。

references.title: The Best Dehumidifiers for Basements, Crawl Spaces & Damp Areas

en.commentary:
Midea's Cube 50 Pint keeps the top spot on the same drainage and quiet-operation combination that's held it there for weeks, a 9.6 drainage score paired with 9.3 on noise. Worth adding today is a distinction that matters more in October than in July: Consumer Reports' basement and crawl space testing treats dehumidifiers differently from the room-by-room reviews most buyers read, because a basement unit runs continuously against a much larger, damper volume of air and needs sustained AHAM-rated capacity measured over continuous operation, a different kind of test than a single peak number captured in a lab.

Midea's 9.6 capacity score holds up under that continuous-load testing specifically because its compressor is rated for the kind of round-the-clock cycling a basement actually demands over months of runtime. The pump-equipped Cube 50 variant holds second for exactly this use case, letting a basement unit drain continuously into a floor drain without the daily bucket-emptying that makes a 50-pint tank impractical for anyone who isn't checking the basement every day.

Frigidaire's FHDD5034W1 rounds out the top three on a 9.3 value score, a real option for anyone whose basement runs damp seasonally, where the Midea's continuous-duty advantage matters less.

highlights.title: Basement Testing Measures a Different Thing Than a Lab Spec Sheet
highlights.body: Consumer Reports' basement and crawl space testing demands sustained AHAM-rated capacity over continuous operation, a tougher bar than the single peak number most lab tests capture.

highlights.title: Midea's Capacity Score Holds Up Under Continuous Load
highlights.body: Its 9.6 capacity score reflects a compressor rated for the kind of round-the-clock cycling a damp basement actually demands over months of runtime.

highlights.title: The Pump Variant Solves the Daily Bucket Problem
highlights.body: The pump-equipped Cube 50 drains continuously into a floor drain, removing the daily emptying that makes a 50-pint tank impractical for an unwatched basement.

highlights.title: Frigidaire Fits Seasonal Dampness Better Than Year-Round Duty
highlights.body: A 9.3 value score makes it a real option for a basement that only runs damp part of the year, where continuous-duty engineering matters less.

zh-tw.commentary:
Midea Cube 50 Pint 繼續守住第一，靠的還是那套撐了好幾週的排水跟靜音組合，排水分數9.6分配上噪音分數9.3分。今天想補充一個十月比七月更有意義的區別，Consumer Reports 對地下室跟爬行空間的測試方式，跟大部分讀者看到的逐房間評測不一樣，因為地下室機型要持續對抗更大、更潮濕的空氣量，需要的是連續運轉下的AHAM標準容量，跟實驗室測到的單次峰值數字是完全不同的測試方式。

Midea 的9.6分容量分數能在這種連續負載測試下站得住，原因是它的壓縮機本來就是為了地下室那種跨月持續運轉的循環強度設計的。有加幫浦的Cube 50版本守住第二，正好對應這種使用情境，讓地下室機型能持續排到地板排水口，不用每天清水箱，這對沒辦法天天檢查地下室的人來說，50品脫水箱本來就很不實際。

Frigidaire FHDD5034W1排進前三，靠的是9.3分的性價比分數，適合地下室只是季節性潮濕、不用整年持續對抗濕氣的人，這種情況下Midea 連續運轉的優勢就沒那麼重要。

highlights.title: 地下室測試跟實驗室規格表測的是不同東西
highlights.body: Consumer Reports 的地下室測試要求連續運轉下的AHAM容量，比大部分實驗室測到的單次峰值數字標準更嚴格。

highlights.title: Midea 的容量分數在連續負載下站得住
highlights.body: 9.6分的容量分數反映它的壓縮機本來就是為地下室那種跨月持續運轉的循環強度設計的。

highlights.title: 幫浦版本解決每天清水箱的問題
highlights.body: 有幫浦的Cube 50版本能持續排到地板排水口，省掉每天清水箱的麻煩，這對沒辦法天天檢查地下室的人特別重要。

highlights.title: Frigidaire 更適合季節性潮濕的地下室
highlights.body: 9.3分的性價比分數讓它適合只是季節性潮濕的地下室，這種情況下連續運轉的工程優勢就沒那麼重要。
